leadSuiteChat.title: Log your contacts
leadSuiteChat.intro: Tell me the business, the channel, when and what you sent. I'll log it.
leadSuiteChat.example1: I messaged Inmobiliaria Sur on WhatsApp today at 3pm, I sent: Hi, I saw your site and can help you get more inquiries.
leadSuiteChat.example2: Yesterday I emailed Café Central offering a website redesign.
leadSuiteChat.example3: Inmobiliaria Sur replied, we have a meeting on Thursday.
leadSuiteChat.placeholder: Ask Leadtita to find, log or write…
leadSuiteChat.hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.

contextFull.title: This conversation got too long for Leadtita.
contextFull.body: Start a new chat to keep going: your leads and contacts stay saved.

leadSuiteChat.pageIntro: Write to me like you'd talk to a teammate. I'll ask you to confirm before saving anything or spending credits.
leadSuiteChat.pageExample1: Yesterday I messaged Southside Realty on WhatsApp offering them a new website.
leadSuiteChat.pageExample2: How is my follow-up going? Give me feedback.
leadSuiteChat.pageExample3: Write a message for Central Café offering them more online bookings.
leadSuiteChat.pageExample4: Add a lead: Main Street Hardware, Denver, +1 303 555 0123.
leadSuiteChat.pageExample5: Find me 10 real estate agencies in Austin, United States.
